Thursday, October 8, 1981. Continuation of the interview with Teddy McRae. And we have along with us an apprentice interviewer for this interview, Ms. Catherine Golter. My name is Ron Welburn. Okay, Teddy.
My name is Teddy McRae. Here again today. Okay.
We were talking about Chick Webb's demise. He had been in the hospital -- this was before his death. Then you were -- the band was performing in Florida and you did not know that he had died.
Oh, Montgomery, Alabama. Okay. What happened after that? Did the band go to his funeral? What were the events that occurred after Chick Webb's death?
